svg.title: bank conflicts
svg.text: Bank conflicts in the score loop: lane c reads Kj[c · stride + x] at x = 5
32 banks of 4 bytes; word address a lives in bank a mod 32; one bank serves one address per cycle
stride 64 (D): bank = (64c + 5) mod 32 = 5 for every lane → 32-way conflict, 32 cycles
stride 65 (D + 1): bank = (c + 5) mod 32 → all 32 banks different, 1 cycle
Stores and loads both use stride 65, so the extra column is never read: correctness is unchanged. 2377 → 339 ms (7.0×).
animated: stride 64 serves one lane per cycle (red sweep); stride 65 serves all 32 at once (green flash)
